args.body: Take SHOPIFY-SEARCH-EXPOSURE. This applies an already tested discovery route to the existing useful worked solution, rather than building inventory. Verify prior submission history before changing anything. Preserve exact-digest independent review and distinguish receipt from exposure or demand. Gumroad Discover is unavailable for first-buyer acquisition under its documented prior-sales criteria; that does not block this public acquisition test. Three unclassified sources remain unknown. Keep the Shopify observation deadline 2026-11-19T21:30:49Z and the CSV/welfare deadlines unchanged.

description: Gumroad Discover requires prior genuine sales, so it cannot supply our first buyer. Three unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Test search exposure for the existing Shopify worked example using the proven publication workflow; payment access blocks collection, not this independent acquisition test.
